hints.title: Recursive Serialization Tree Traversal
hints.text: Converting arbitrary data structures into standard serialized text strings requires discriminating primitives, arrays, and nested dictionaries.

hints.title: Type-Specific String Serialization
hints.text: Format null, booleans, and numbers directly. Wrap strings in double quotes. For arrays, recursively serialize each element separated by commas. For objects, map key-value pairs formatted with colon delimiters.

hints.title: Recursive Stringify Blueprint
hints.text: If obj === null return "null". If typeof obj === "string" return `"${obj}"`. If boolean or number return String(obj). If Array.isArray(obj), map items with jsonStringify and join inside brackets. Otherwise iterate Object.keys(obj) mapping `"${k}":${jsonStringify(obj[k])}` inside braces.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Visits each key and primitive value once during serialization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generic toString methods produce [object Object] instead of valid double-quoted key-value syntax.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct string concatenation scales with output string size without intermediate buffering.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly escaping strings and handling null properly since typeof null is object.
